faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in OAV Khordha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 Supporting Staff vacancies announced by Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Khordha in this recruitment drive. These positions are for various roles including Warden, Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper, Head Cook, and Assistant Cook, offering diverse opportunities for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for OAV Khordha Supporting Staff posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application form for the Supporting Staff posts at OAV Khordha is 21 August 2026. Candidates are advised to ensure their applications reach the designated address well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for OAV Khordha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the OAV Khordha Supporting Staff Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and send it along with the required documents via post.

faq.question: Q4. What are the qualifications required for OAV Khordha Supporting Staff posts?
faq.answer: The qualifications vary by post. For Warden, a B.A./B.Sc. is required, while for Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper, an HSC is needed. For other posts like Head Cook and Assistant Cook, candidates should refer to the official notification for specific details.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for OAV Khordha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for the OAV Khordha Supporting Staff Recruitment 2026. Both General/OBC and SC/ST categories are exempted from paying any application fee, making it accessible for all eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for Supporting Staff in OAV Khordha?
faq.answer: The selection process for Supporting Staff at OAV Khordha includes several stages. Candidates will undergo Document Verification, followed by an Interview. A Practical Cooking Test might be conducted for relevant posts, and a final Merit List will be prepared based on performance.

faq.question: Q7. What is the official website for OAV Khordha Recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Khordha recruitment and related information is www.khordha.odisha.gov.in. Candidates can visit this site to download the application form and access the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for the Warden post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Warden post under OAV Khordha Recruitment 2026 is Rs. 21,175/- per month. This is a contractual position offering a competitive remuneration for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Are these permanent or contractual jobs?
faq.answer: These jobs for Supporting Staff at Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Khordha are contractual. The recruitment aims to fill positions on a contract basis, providing an opportunity for individuals seeking government employment in the short to medium term.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for these posts?
faq.answer: The job location for the Supporting Staff posts is Khordha, Odisha. Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Khordha is situated in Khordha, Pincode 752056, making it a local opportunity for residents of the region.
